# Keyboard Layout Designer Project

This project is a web application for creating custom keyboard layouts with ergonomic finger mapping functionality.

## Project Overview
- **Type**: Web Application
- **Technologies**: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (Vanilla)
- **Target**: Tablet-optimized interface for finger mapping
- **Output**: Ergogen-compatible keyboard layout files

## Key Features
- Interactive finger mapping wizard
- Row/column configuration
- Individual finger position tracking (10 taps per position)
- Color-coded key visualization
- Left/right hand mapping with mirroring support
- Ergogen format export
- Touch-optimized UI for tablets

## Development Guidelines
- Focus on touch interaction and gesture support
- Implement responsive design for various screen sizes
- Use modern JavaScript for touch event handling
- Prioritize accessibility and user experience
- Generate clean, exportable layout data

## File Structure
- `index.html` - Main application interface
- `css/` - Stylesheets for responsive design
- `js/` - JavaScript modules for mapping logic
- `data/` - Sample layouts and export templates
